findings.text: the pre-existing lapse branch in _wait returns True out of watch_ticker, so the CLI exits 0 for the same lost seat this node exists to have restarted, leaving the defect reachable whenever the lapse is observed at _wait's entry rather than during its own sleep; route that return through runs.exit_lost_watch_seat

watch_lease_lapsed re-derives the lapse predicate the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:3219 (_lease_remaining) instead of extending it, so the two owners can change without the other and the split above survives

only a live follower renews the registration (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1817), so a project with no live runs now exits with WATCH_SEAT_LOST_EXIT every lease interval and is respawned each time, a new steady-state churn on idle projects that the fragment does not mention

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_producer_survives_without_linger.py with its negative control, plus no added failures against the base revision on all_debug with at most -n 4; the manifest records both arms (arm-base.log, arm-after.log) and the red negative-control.log, and its tests line is the command that ran.
VERDICT write_paths: read the six declared paths against the diff; all five files the two commits touch lie inside them (reckon/crew/runs.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py, both test files, the evidence fragment), and the declared figures directory is untouched.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records commits 20f749a4c1 and 7707166cdf, both arms green (8 passed at base, 12 passed at head), the negative control red with test_a_lapsed_lease_is_restarted_without_a_unit failing, and the head commit resolves in the reviewed tree.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against a5764282bdee; 20f749a4c1 changes the producer's exit path, the supervisor's restart rule and the tests, and 7707166cdf adds only the landing fragment, 427 insertions and 16 deletions across five files.

SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: arm-base.log and arm-after.log carry revision, tree, command, module and cwd headers with EXIT=0 and 8 and 12 passed, and negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 naming test_a_lapsed_lease_is_restarted_without_a_unit; the done_when's ruff half is claimed rather than logged, so I re-ran ruff check and ruff format --check over the four changed source and test paths and both are clean.

JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the two commits is one of the six declared write paths, and the plan is untouched -- the landing lives in docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-project-s-watch-producer-survives-when-linger-is-unavailab.html.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_producer_survives_without_linger.py:135 asserts a second producer start after a lapsed lease and the recorded negative control reddens exactly that assertion, and :225 asserts returncode 75 for a seat taken at renewal; the untested residual is the recovery_watch.py:3227 return.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the additions follow the surrounding idiom -- a module constant and docstringed predicate at reckon/crew/runs.py:3867-3915, and a supervisor that asks the module for the seat answer rather than reimplementing it at reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:280 -- and every new name states a mechanism rather than a plan label.
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/runs.py:3870 watch_lease_lapsed re-derives the lapse predicate the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:3219 (_lease_remaining), and neither side was refactored onto the other, so the two can drift.
